description.en: Skill and MCP server for adding the ClaraConverts website chat agent (voice and text) to a site: creates a trial account, returns the embed snippet, loads the site content, and changes settings and integrations.
description.zh: 提供安装 Skill 与 MCP 服务器，用于把 ClaraConverts 网站对话代理（语音与文字）添加到网站：创建试用账户、返回嵌入代码、载入网站内容，并修改设置与集成。
